focus.title: 欧盟拟对华电动汽车加征临时反补贴关税，中企需加速供应链合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于2026年7月23日公布对华电动汽车反补贴调查初步裁定，拟对进口自中国的纯电动汽车加征17%至36%的临时反补贴税。该措施预计于8月生效，为期四个月。受影响企业可申请听证并提出价格承诺。建议中国车企立即审查出口产品补贴构成，调整欧洲定价策略，并考虑在欧盟境内设立组装线以降低税负。
focus.title_en: EU Proposes Provisional Countervailing Duties on Chinese EVs; Chinese Firms Urged to Accelerate Compliance
focus.summary_en: On July 23, 2026, the European Commission published its preliminary countervailing duty determination on Chinese electric vehicles, proposing a 17% to 36% provisional tariff on BEVs imported from China. The measure is expected to take effect in August for four months. Affected companies may request hearings and offer price undertakings. Chinese EV makers should immediately review subsidy components in export products, adjust EU pricing strategies, and consider setting up assembly lines within the EU to mitigate duties.

case.title: 英国高等法院认定中国仲裁条款有效，驳回当事人以“仲裁员国籍”为由的撤裁申请
case.summary: 2026年7月，英国高等法院在审理一起中英合资企业纠纷案时，驳回一方当事人以“仲裁员均为中国籍，无法保证中立性”为由提出的撤销仲裁裁决申请。法院强调，当事人自愿选择中国仲裁机构（CIETAC）即应受其规则约束，仲裁员国籍本身不构成偏见。该案警示中国企业：在跨境合同中选择仲裁地及仲裁员国籍时，应充分评估其法律后果，避免事后挑战。
case.source: 来源：英国高等法院判例 · 2026年7月
case.title_en: UK High Court Upholds Chinese Arbitration Clause, Rejects Challenge Based on Arbitrator Nationality
case.summary_en: In July 2026, the UK High Court dismissed an application to set aside a CIETAC award in a Sino-British joint venture dispute, rejecting the argument that all-Chinese arbitrators could not guarantee neutrality. The court held that parties voluntarily choosing a Chinese arbitral institution are bound by its rules, and arbitrator nationality alone does not establish bias. This case warns Chinese enterprises to carefully assess the legal implications of arbitration seat and arbitrator nationality in cross-border contracts to avoid post-award challenges.
case.source_en: Source: UK High Court Judgment · July 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”机制扩围，新增医疗与金融行业试点
policy.summary: 2026年7月，广东省网信办联合港澳相关部门发布通知，将大湾区数据跨境流动“白名单”试点扩展至医疗健康与金融服务领域。符合条件的企业在申报个人信息出境时，可适用简化安全评估程序。企业需建立数据分类分级制度，并指定数据保护官。此举将显著降低合规成本，但企业仍需确保数据接收方具备同等保护水平。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026年7月
policy.title_en: GBA Cross-Border Data Flow 'White List' Expanded to Include Healthcare and Finance Sectors
policy.summary_en: In July 2026, the Guangdong Cyberspace Administration, together with Hong Kong and Macao authorities, expanded the Greater Bay Area data cross-border 'white list' pilot to healthcare and financial services. Eligible enterprises may apply for simplified security assessments when transferring personal information abroad. Companies must establish data classification and grading systems and appoint a data protection officer. This move significantly reduces compliance costs, but enterprises must ensure that data recipients maintain equivalent protection levels.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期合规要点——中国企业应尽快建立产品碳足迹核算体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）已于2026年1月进入正式征收阶段，但过渡期报告义务仍持续至2026年底。中国出口企业（尤其钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力行业）须在2026年12月31日前提交第三季度及年度碳排放报告。建议企业立即启动产品级碳足迹核算，对接欧盟认可的第三方核查机构，并关注CBAM证书价格走势。未按时报告将面临每吨碳排放50-100欧元的罚款，且可能被列入进口商黑名单。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 律连全球 · 2026.07.24
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: CBAM Transition Compliance – Chinese Exporters Must Establish Product Carbon Footprint Accounting Systems
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) entered its definitive phase in January 2026, but transitional reporting obligations continue until end-2026. Chinese exporters (especially in steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizers, and electricity) must submit Q3 and annual carbon emission reports by December 31, 2026. Companies should immediately initiate product-level carbon footprint accounting, engage EU-recognized third-party verifiers, and monitor CBAM certificate prices. Failure to report on time may result in fines of €50-100 per tonne of embedded emissions and potential blacklisting by importers.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · iGlobal Law · 2026.07.24
